name: Forgotten Forest
objective: Defeat the Forest Scout before time runs out.
lose_text: You lose if your health reaches 0 or the timer ends.
hints: Drag the left stick to MOVE.
Push the stick UP to JUMP onto platforms (down to drop).
Tap ATTACK when close to the enemy.
Tap MOBILITY to dash through attacks.
SPECIAL and SIGNATURE need cooldowns; ULTIMATE needs a full meter.

name: Molten Cavern
objective: Defeat the Ember Duelist. Avoid the lava pit!
lose_text: Lava burns! You lose if health reaches 0 or time ends.
hints: The lava pit damages anyone who falls in.

name: Frozen Citadel
objective: Defeat the Frost Ranger. The ice floor is slippery!
lose_text: You lose if your health reaches 0 or time ends.
hints: The floor is icy: you slide when you stop.

name: Shadow Realm
objective: Defeat the Shade Warden. Dodge the drifting rift orbs!
lose_text: You lose if your health reaches 0 or time ends.
hints: Moving rift orbs hurt anyone they touch.

name: Rift Sanctuary
objective: Defeat the Rift Sovereign. Survive lava, ice and rift surges!
lose_text: You lose if your health reaches 0 or time ends.
hints: Final battle! The Sovereign grows stronger at half health.
